key: When thou drawest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
s: Opening the siege laws, which order a resisting far city’s males killed and the land’s nations destroyed, the verse sets the first step; Rashi, on 20:10, reads it as speaking of discretionary war, and Ramban, on the same verse, as requiring the call to peace even with the seven nations, the section distinguishing the wars only at its end.

evidence.gloss: [Rashi, on 20:10:] Scripture speaks of a discretionary war, as is made explicit in the section. … [Ramban, on 20:10, after quoting Rashi:] The intent of our Rabbis in this verse is only to say that the section, at its end, distinguishes between the two wars; but the call to peace applies even in a commanded war, for we are obliged to call for peace even to the seven nations.

reason: verse.js ok, ref Deuteronomy 20:10 and at [172,10] match. Plain sense faithful: 20:10 opens the laws on approaching a city; 20:13 to 14 order a refusing far city’s males smitten, 20:16 to 17 the land’s nations destroyed; stated plainly (rule 6), no four-word run from the key. Read every packet source on 20:10 (Rashi, Ibn Ezra, Ramban; Rashbam and Sforno nothing; Deuteronomy Rabbah 5:12 to 5:15) and Rashi, Ramban and Rashbam on 20:11 to 18. Rashi’s words carry ‘discretionary war’ exactly (במלחמת הרשות). Ramban’s words carry the call to peace even to the seven nations in a commanded war, and that the section distinguishes the wars at its end. CORRECTED: the proposal ended ‘the two wars differing only after refusal’, but Ramban goes on (ונראה שיש הפרש עוד בשאלת השלום) to name a further difference in the peace terms themselves (the seven nations must also renounce idolatry), so ‘only’ went beyond him; replaced by ‘the section distinguishing the wars only at its end’, his own שהפרשה בסופה תחלק בין שתי המלחמות. To stay within 60 words, Rashi’s ‘a war of choice’ became ‘discretionary war’ (his מלחמת הרשות). Source line: Ramban’s edition named “On Your Way new” as the packet gives it. Disagreement named, not resolved (rule 5). entry-check ok on scratch/V-d062-p.json.
